workspace.title: Travel policy
workspace.description: Rules, rates and providers of the travel cost calculator.

common.justificationHint: At least {{count}} characters. Saved in the audit trail.

panel.title: Travel and logistics costs
panel.subtitleQuotation: Estimate the travel of the audit team from their base to the client's sites, compare itineraries and use the approved total on the quotation.
panel.subtitlePlan: Estimate the travel of this audit, approve it, then record the actual costs to see the variance.
panel.samples: Sample rates still to confirm in the travel policy: {{count}}.
panel.warnings: Some inputs could not be priced
panel.secondApprover: A manual change above the approval threshold must be approved by another CAB user or the CAB administrator.
panel.amountFromEstimate: Filled from the approved estimate {{number}}. Change the estimate to change this amount.
panel.amountManual: Approve an estimate to fill this amount, or enter it yourself (a manual amount is not a confirmed price).

banner.estimateText: Some lines are benchmarks, advance prices, demo offers or manual amounts. Valid until {{date}}; refresh before the client approves or before booking.
banner.confirmedText: Every line comes from a connected provider or a confirmed policy rate. Valid until {{date}}.
banner.staleText: The audit dates, team or sites changed since this estimate was priced.
banner.expiredText: The prices expired on {{date}}. Refresh them before using this estimate.

inputs.remoteHint: A remote audit has no physical travel, so no travel costs.
inputs.endBeforeStart: The last day must be on or after the first day.
inputs.cityFromAddress: Find the city in the address
inputs.notLocated: Location not found: choose the city.
inputs.teamFromStep: The team comes from the previous step.
inputs.noTeam: Add at least one auditor to price the travel.

table.title: Cost breakdown
table.empty: No travel costs for this audit.

adjust.title: Adjust a cost line
adjust.placeholder: Why this amount? For example: corporate hotel rate, contract reference.
adjust.needsApproval: This change is above the approval threshold: another CAB user or the CAB administrator must approve the estimate.

addLine.title: Add a documented cost
addLine.description: For a cost the calculator does not know, with its supporting document.

actuals.title: Actual travel costs
actuals.description: Enter what was really paid for each line, with the receipt or invoice reference. Leave empty to clear.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.load: The travel cost data could not be loaded.
errors.stale: The inputs changed since this estimate was priced. Refresh it, then approve it again.
errors.expired: The prices of this estimate expired. Refresh them first.
errors.separation: You made a change above the approval threshold: another CAB user or the CAB administrator must approve.
errors.notPriced: Nothing could be priced: check the sites' cities and the auditors' bases.

statusHint.LIVE: Price from a connected provider, with its retrieval time and offer expiry.
statusHint.CACHED: Live price reused from a recent search; its age is shown.
statusHint.ADVANCE_ESTIMATE: Provider price for a date far ahead; expected to change before booking.
statusHint.BENCHMARK: Estimate from the travel policy; the assumption is shown.
statusHint.POLICY: Rate confirmed by your CAB in the travel policy.
statusHint.MANUAL: Amount entered or changed by a person, with a justification.
statusHint.DEMO: Sample data for demonstration; never a real price.

horizon.LIVE_WINDOW: Near term: live prices when a provider is connected
horizon.BEYOND_HORIZON: Beyond the booking window: benchmark prices

providers.title: Pricing providers
providers.intro: Live prices need a connected provider. Without one, every price is a labelled benchmark from this policy.
providers.phase2: Phase 2: provider integration (flight, hotel and FX APIs) and the CAB's own confirmed rates. Until then, estimates use the configurable sample rates of this policy.

hint.demo: Sample data: shown as Demo, never as live prices.
hint.on: Connected; used to estimate, not a market price.
hint.off: No provider: the benchmark rates of this policy are used.

policy.title: Travel policy
policy.subtitle: The rules and rates the travel cost calculator uses when no live price is available.
policy.samplesText: The seeded rates are examples, not official figures. Check each row, change it if needed and tick Confirmed.

settings.maxExtraHoursForSaving: Extra hours accepted to save money
settings.perDiemOnLocalAudits: Pay per diem on local audits

policy.countriesHint: Per diem, hotel cap and visa fee per country. The visa fee applies to auditors based in another country.
policy.railHint: No rail booking service is connected: these fares are used and shown as benchmarks.
